key_insight: General-purpose, vision-language, and foundation models were benchmarked against dermatology-specific classifiers, and the study found that robustness remains a major challenge under real-world shifts in skin lesion data.
clinical_relevance: This work highlights that promising AI models still need careful validation across imaging modalities, devices, and patient groups before they can be considered reliable for clinical dermatology.
method: Evaluated dermoscopic images and smartphone clinical photos
Tested performance under distribution, modality, and demographic shifts
evidence_signal: The abstract describes a systematic benchmark on recent dermatology datasets, assessing robustness across heterogeneous data sources and comparing task-specific classifiers with foundation and vision-language models.
watch_item: Results may not fully generalize to new clinical settings without external validation on locally representative data and workflow testing.
paper_title: Bridging Research and Practice: A Systematic Evaluation of Generalist and Dermatology-Specific Models in Clinical Skin Lesion Classification
